references.text: Describes Aaron's death on Mount Hor, where he was 'gathered to his people' - the same expression used for Moses' upcoming death
The Lord repeats that Moses shall be gathered to his people after the confrontation with the Midianites
Moses is allowed to see the land from the top of Pisgah but is not permitted to cross the Jordan
Parallel text where the Lord commands Moses to go up Mount Nebo to see the land before he dies
The fulfillment of the prophecy - Moses sees the land from Nebo and dies in the land of Moab
The expression 'gathered to his people' is also used regarding Abraham's death
The same expression 'gathered to his people' is used regarding Jacob's death
